action: If you use Bitly links in emails, ads or printed material, spot-check that key links still lead to the right pages and watch for an official Bitly statement. No other action while unconfirmed.
exec: Unconfirmed report that Bitly links were redirected; relevant to any organisation using short links in customer communications.
plain: An incident tracker says shortened web links from the link-shortening service Bitly were hijacked on November 15. There are no details yet and the report is unconfirmed.
summary: An incident tracker lists a hijacking of shortened web links at the URL-shortening service on November 15. No detail on scale or cause was available in the listing; treat as unconfirmed until better sourcing appears.
title: Bitly short links hijacked
